methodological_rigor.justification: The normalized manuscript contains only the title, '[Retracted] EGFR expression is associated with cytoplasmic staining of CXCR4 and predicts poor prognosis in triple-negative breast carcinomas,' with no abstract, methods, results, cohort description, or endpoint definitions. Because no design details, sample size, controls, confounder handling, or statistical methods are present in the text, the claims in the title cannot be evaluated from the available manuscript. The retraction marker in the title further prevents treating the work as reliable evidence, but no retraction details are provided in the corpus.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: The title concerns EGFR, CXCR4 staining, and prognosis in triple-negative breast carcinoma, which is clinically relevant in principle, but the available text provides no patient population, assay methods, outcomes, or effect estimates. With only a title and no evaluable study design, the level of evidence cannot be classified as cohort or case-control evidence and is conservatively assigned LoE 5. The '[Retracted]' label also means the corpus does not support clinical use of the claim.

reporting_quality.justification: A prognostic biomarker manuscript would most closely fall under REMARK, but the normalized file includes no methods, patient inclusion criteria, assay description, statistical analysis, results, limitations, or data availability statement. No underlying data, code, protocols, or supplementary materials are present in the text. Reporting is therefore not sufficient for independent appraisal or replication.

novelty_literature.justification: The title suggests an association between EGFR expression, CXCR4 staining pattern, and prognosis in triple-negative breast cancer, a biomarker-prognosis topic with many established comparators. Because the corpus contains no introduction, literature positioning, methods, or results, it does not document a credible gap or new contribution. The '[Retracted]' marker further limits any originality claim supported by the available manuscript.

writing_presentation.justification: The only scientific content available is a title, so there is no abstract, section organization, results narrative, tables, figure captions, or discussion to evaluate. The title is understandable but cannot support a publication-readiness assessment. The absence of manuscript body text prevents assessment of clarity, accuracy, and presentation quality.

key_strengths: The title identifies a potentially relevant prognostic biomarker question in triple-negative breast carcinoma.
key_concerns: The normalized manuscript contains only a title and no evaluable methods, results, or discussion.
The title is explicitly marked '[Retracted]', so the available record should not be treated as reliable evidence.
No statistical methods, cohort characteristics, endpoint definitions, or data availability information are present.
chief_reviewer.rationale: With only a retracted title available, the manuscript cannot be evaluated as a publishable scientific report. Even at the lowest tier, the correct recommendation is rejection because the corpus lacks the content required for appraisal.
